_doc: helloAO editions whose verse strings carry the translator's FOOTNOTES inline (helloAO's own data: the note's \fr \fq \ft parts glued into the verse, e.g. HINIRV RUT 2:9 '…चला करना2:9 उन्हीं के पीछे-पीछे चला करना: उनके खेतों…'). helloao_source removes exactly the note texts the edition's eBible USFM marks with \f … \f* (pinned zip below; download it once from `url`). Found 2026-10-09 by the LLM pilot (it marked the notes as explanations); scan of all 774 helloAO editions: only HINIRV (7.3% of verses). nhe_tbl's bracketed [C:V …] notes are in the source text itself (eBible too, no \f markup): a text_strip_rules question, not this.
